title: PeridotID relayer absorbed-loss USD caps (ANT-602, OQ-3 condition 3)
method: derived from the native OQ-3 caps at the reference rates below; re-tune with the native caps after 7 days of sustained traffic (cap = 100 x p99 single-tx absorbed, native AND usd), CTO sign-off. No mainnet values change without the audit gate (R-NFR-10) and a board order.

referenceRates.note: EXAMPLE rates used ONLY to derive the initial USD caps. Runtime conversion ALWAYS uses relayer_price_rates (fresh ≤ PRICE_STALE_AFTER_SEC), never these numbers.

priceFeed.refreshCadence: every 5 min (same tick as alert checks)
priceFeed.stalenessRule: rate older than PRICE_STALE_AFTER_SEC → PAGE on staleness, SKIP usd burn eval for that chain (fail-closed; native-unit Q4 still pages)

receivers.page: ALERT_PAGE_URL (on-call; staleness pages on-call, not Security)
